messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert for tenant LatticeBank (VPC lb-197) — elevated 95th latency + error rate on dedicated-pool-3. Affects /v1/chat and /v1/generate. Paging oncall-sre-maria.

pagerduty: Incident has been acknowledged by maria.

maria: I'm on it. Joining now, will triage. Any immediate customer impact notes?

ryan: CS: LatticeBank says their payment retry job is timing out; several failed transactions in the last 15m. They classified it as "high business impact" and want continuous updates.

kevin: infra: I see sustained GPU queue backlog on dedicated-pool-3, device memory nearing 100% on some workers and OOM restarts. Host-level cpu is fine. Metrics show spike coincident with the model rollout 14:02 UTC.

anya: ml-eng: we rolled ml/v2.14 to production targeted at latency improvements ~14:00. Could be an interaction with KV cache growth for long conversation state.

jess: eng-prod: I reproduced a similar spike locally by replaying long-convo traces (seq_len ~2048) against v2.14; KV cache lookup time increases nonlinearly and causes token latency to jump.

maria: Triage summary — probable regression from ml/v2.14 under long-sequence workloads for this tenant. Impact: LatticeBank (restricted to dedicated-pool-3) seeing timeouts and errors. Plan: short, safe mitigations to restore customer while we root cause.

maria: Mitigation plan (ordered):
1) Tenant-level model override: pin LatticeBank to ml/v2.13-sv (safe-variant) via tenant-overrides API. No other tenants touched.
2) Add two spare nodes to dedicated-pool-3 (quick scale up).
3) Put ml/v2.14 rollout on hold and gather traces.
4) If pin fails, fail open to compatible smaller model variant (ml/v2.12-compact) as emergency fallback.

jess: I'll prepare the tenant override. Using the tenant-overrides API so it doesn't affect other customers. Example patch:

```bash
curl -X PATCH https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/lb-197/overrides \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model": "ml/v2.13-sv", "reason": "P1 mitigation: degrade to safe variant for seq len regression"}'
```

kevin: Scaling pool now:

```bash
# scale plan (k8s cluster autoscaler + pool resize)
kubectl -n redwood-gpu scale deployment dedicated-pool-3 --replicas=8
# current replicas 6 -> 8
```

kevin: Scale request accepted, new nodes requested — ETA ~90s to schedule. Monitoring for OOMs.

maria: Applying tenant override now.

jess: Patch applied, API returned 200.

maria: Confirming traffic routing: requests from lb-197 are being served by ml/v2.13-sv; preliminary p99 latency down from 2.3s -> 0.9s, error rate dropping.

anya: Good. Note: ml/v2.13-sv differs in quantization and some tokenization edge cases; we should warn CS about possible subtle output changes.

ryan: Noted. I'll tell LatticeBank that we've pinned them to a safe variant and are monitoring, with possible small differences in completions.

kevin: New nodes healthy, GPU queues relieved, OOM restarts stopped.

incident-bot: Status update: mitigation in progress — tenant pinned to ml/v2.13-sv, pool scaled. Please update incident channel as you make progress.

maria: Customer impact now substantially reduced. Marking incident as mitigated for immediate customer-facing impact; still keeping incident open for RCA and rollout gating.

jess: Action items for follow-up:
- ml: bisect v2.14 changes to find KV cache growth trigger.
- infra: add stronger OOM alerts and safe node buffer for dedicated pools with enterprise tenants.
- platform: extend tenant-overrides runbook with an explicit rollback/pin checklist and sample curl commands.

anya: Also add an automated safe-variant fallback into the routing policy: if a tenant's endpoint sees >X% errors for 5m after a model rollout, auto-route to configured safe-variant for that tenant. We should make this throttleable.

maria: Agreed. I'll own the postmortem. Immediate owners: anya (root cause & fix), kevin (capacity/runbook), jess (rollout gating + runbook), ryan (customer comms).

ryan: Sent initial update to LatticeBank: "We've pinned your tenant to a tested safe variant and scaled capacity to stabilize. Our engineers are investigating root cause; we'll share a follow-up in 4 hours."

maria: Closing note: don't merge further model rollout PRs to dedicated pools until we have the RCA and a safe rollout checklist.

incident-bot: Incident status set to RESOLVED->MITIGATED by maria.

maria: Postmortem to follow. TL;DR — tenant-level pin + pool scale resolved immediate customer impact. Next: automated safe-variant fallback and rollout telemetry for long-convo workloads.
